says: In next/, the generated person.json gives desktop.brain-memory the pattern for digits only and the default "500000000", the byte size's JSON codec, while the settings note says a byte size has one spelling, a string with its unit, and the loader reads "500 MB". An editor using this schema marks the documented spelling as wrong. The two byte-size settings are not declared the same way: on the branch fabrikalfa/pipe-plumbing, mail.chunk is declared with format: "text", and its generated repo.json entry is a plain string with the default "65536 bytes" and no digit pattern; desktop.brain-memory in Declarations.ts has no format, so it takes the default json format.
proof: `pnpm settings:generate` at 6bc41cab8 wrote that pattern. DesktopBrain.test.ts L9 reads a size with its unit through a provider and a flag. On origin/fabrikalfa/pipe-plumbing (17ca44766), next/packages/libfabrika/src/settings/Declarations.ts line 224 declares mailChunk with format: "text", and next/apps/fabrika/repo.json lines 15 to 18 give it type string and default "65536 bytes".
cost: A person who writes the documented value sees an editor error on a valid setting.
